name: James Cline
tagline: Typical Harvest Dates for Crops in Georgia
description: James Cline is a working farm in 3rd Avenue, GA. It grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Blackberries, Apples, and Pears, with seasonal availability through spring, summer, and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Mar – Jun in this growing zone.
